render_vector_sketches_to_raster: render a list of vector stroke sketches into grayscale raster images using Cairo
render_vector_sketches_with_part_colors: render vector sketches as RGB images with each body part drawn in a distinct color
extract_vector_strokes_by_target_part: extract and organize vector strokes for a specific target body part from doodle sketch data
process_doodle_data_for_doodlergan: process bird or creature doodle sketches into train and test JSON splits for DoodlerGAN
save_sketch_descriptions_to_json: extract and save text descriptions from doodle sketch data into a JSON file
